s3Recovery.title: Recover an instance from S3
s3Recovery.intro: Migrate or recover a Minecraft instance using a Fabricator backup. The source installation and local backup index are not required. This does not restore Fabricator accounts or installation settings.
s3Recovery.profileHint: An operator must configure this alias with allowImport enabled. Credentials stay on the backend.
s3Recovery.empty: No supported Fabricator snapshots on this page. Check the original bucket and prefix; unrelated S3 objects are not importable.
s3Recovery.name: New instance name
s3Recovery.nameHint: Use 1–80 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens. Existing instances are never replaced.
s3Recovery.manual: Supply original launch details manually (legacy or platform migration)
s3Recovery.legacyHint: Old backups did not store these details. Supply the actual game version, loader build and a relative launch target present in the archive. Custom commands, host paths and unsafe launch flags require manual migration.
s3Recovery.stagingHint: Temporary local disk is required for the archive and staged instance. Remote objects are read-only during recovery.
s3Recovery.restartHint: After a panel restart or lost contact, check the instance list before retrying. Reopen this dialog to resume a saved preview.
s3Recovery.removed: {count} known administrative or installation-control paths removed.
s3Recovery.secretHint: Only relative file names are shown. Values are never displayed. Rotate or replace retained credentials and review external connections before starting.
s3Recovery.scanTruncated: Some large or non-text files were not scanned. Detection is not a guarantee that the archive is secret-free.
s3Recovery.acknowledge: I trust the archived server code and reviewed platform, Java, player data and extra listeners. Create a new stopped instance with fresh administration and networking.
s3Recovery.retainSecrets: I explicitly accept retained or uninspected plugin/configuration credentials and will review or rotate them before starting.
s3Recovery.stopped: Nothing was started or installed. Review Java, credentials and custom listeners, then configure networking and map consent on this installation.
s3Recovery.grants: An administrator must grant you access to this new instance ID. Source-installation permissions are not inherited.

packUpdates.title: Staged modpack updates
packUpdates.intro: Review changes, test a separate instance, then approve a backed-up update. Production worlds stay in place.
packUpdates.stopped: Stop production and external file writers before continuing. This workflow never starts production.
packUpdates.runtimeBlocked: Runtime migration required. Minecraft, loader and loader build must match before staging or promotion.
packUpdates.noChanges: No pack-owned mod or config changes.
packUpdates.replaceLocal: Replace this local file in a new review
packUpdates.binary: No text diff available. Inspect this file before replacing it.
packUpdates.clientImpact: Client files: {before} → {after}. Export a new client pack after promotion; existing shares stay unchanged.
packUpdates.acknowledge: I reviewed the changes and copy risks. Staging uses fresh player/admin access and loopback networking; configs may retain secrets or external connections.
packUpdates.execute: I trust this pack and reviewed credentials, external databases and extra listeners. Run staging for up to 180 seconds, then stop it.
packUpdates.stagingPermission: Staging requires view, settings-read, file-read, start and stop permissions. Forks do not inherit grants.
packUpdates.approve: Type “{name}” to approve production changes with a mandatory safety backup.
packUpdates.publishedFailure: Production changed before a later step failed. Inspect production and its safety backup before retrying.
packUpdates.recoveryRequired: Restart the panel for update recovery. Production starts and review deletion stay blocked; keep the journal and backup.
packUpdates.retained: Deleting a review keeps staging and safety backups.

diagnostics.title: Performance history & diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: Compare measurements over time. Gaps mean unavailable data, not zero.
diagnostics.empty: No samples yet. History collects in the background.
diagnostics.noMeasurement: No available measurement in this window.
diagnostics.units: TPS uses loader readings or vanilla tick-cost estimates. MSPT is measured milliseconds per tick. GC counters reset each JVM run. CPU can exceed 100%. Times use your local timezone.
diagnostics.diskScope: Disk measures shared filesystem capacity, not world size or process I/O.
diagnostics.jvmHelp: Uses this server's jstat every 30 seconds, with a 2-second timeout. Missing tools or unsupported collectors remain unavailable. No JDK install or runtime changes.
diagnostics.sparkHelp: Capture while lag occurs, then compare its time window with these trends. Reports provide evidence, not a diagnosis. No install or restart.
diagnostics.unsupported: Guided captures support verified Paper 1.21+ releases only. Other loaders, forks and unknown versions need manual compatibility checks.
diagnostics.notReady: The matching server runtime must be running and ready.
diagnostics.consent: I consent to spark uploading this capture to its external service when the timeout ends. Reports may include server, plugin, world and other operational data. Anyone with the URL may view it; review before sharing.
diagnostics.readOnly: Read-only. Sampling and captures require diagnostics.manage.
diagnostics.noCaptures: No captures. Up to 20 references are kept for 24 hours.

reasons.jstat-unavailable: This Java installation has no jstat tool.
reasons.jstat-probe-failed: jstat returned no measurements. Check Fabricator logs and Java attach permissions.
reasons.process-changed: The JVM changed during collection; this sample was discarded.

worldExports.title: World downloads
worldExports.intro: World-only archives. Private until you create a share link.
worldExports.working: Working... Large exports can take minutes.
worldExports.stopped: Export requires a POSIX host and a stopped instance, including external file writers. It never stops the server. Existing archives remain downloadable while running.
worldExports.contents: Includes all dimensions, player state, datapacks and saved mod data. Excludes server configs, logs and mod/plugin binaries. World data is not anonymized or guaranteed secret-free.
worldExports.noWorlds: No supported world found. Initialize it, then stop the instance.
worldExports.retention: Five archives per server. Unshared archives expire after 24 hours; active links keep theirs until expiry or revocation.
worldExports.privacy: Anyone with the link can download without login. Review the private archive first: player identities, inventories, coordinates, signs, books and mod data may contain private information or secrets. It is not anonymized or guaranteed secret-free.
worldExports.publicRouting: Recipients need HTTPS access to this Fabricator origin and service workers enabled. Private origins need deliberate proxy routing.
worldExports.acknowledge: I reviewed this archive and authorize anonymous access despite its privacy risks.
worldExports.linkOnce: Copy now. This secret link is shown only once.
worldExports.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the link manually.
worldExports.recall: Expiry, revocation or deletion blocks new requests, not downloads already started or saved.
worldExports.confirmRemoval: Block future access? Deleting an archive also invalidates every link to it.
worldExports.publicHelp: One world archive, no dashboard login.
worldExports.publicCompatibility: Java world folders in tar.gz, not a modpack. Match the game, loader, mods and datapacks. Bukkit split worlds need a compatible server or conversion. Data is not anonymized.
worldExports.publicStarted: Download started. Check your browser downloads for progress and completion.
worldExports.unavailable: This world link is unavailable, expired or revoked. Ask its owner for a new link.
worldExports.browserRequired: Use HTTPS (or localhost) and a browser with service workers enabled.
worldExports.limited: Downloads are busy or rate-limited. Wait at least a minute and retry.
worldExports.downloadFailed: Download could not start. Check your connection and browser download permissions, then retry.

transfers.title: Instances & worlds
transfers.subtitle: Create an independent instance, or copy a world without changing its source.
transfers.readOnly: Read-only. Forking or copying worlds requires additional source and destination permissions.
transfers.stoppedOnly: Stop both instances before continuing. Nothing here stops the source, and forks are never started automatically.
transfers.name: New instance name
transfers.nameHelp: Choose a unique name: 1–80 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens. The instance gets its own ID, directory and ports.
transfers.includeWorlds: Copy the existing world and all its dimensions
transfers.newWorld: Do not copy worlds; generate a new world at first start
transfers.playersHelp: Player state includes inventories (playerdata), advancements and stats. Other integral world data and player identities may remain.
transfers.freshAccess: Fresh administrative access: ops, whitelist, bans and player caches are not copied. Online authentication is enabled; RCON, query, proxy forwarding and autostart are disabled.
transfers.keepAccess: Destination ops, whitelist, bans, server properties and mod/plugin configuration stay unchanged.
transfers.noDestinations: No eligible destination. You need world-import and backup-create permissions on another instance.
transfers.noWorlds: No supported initialized world was found. Initialize the source world first, then stop it.
transfers.size: Selected source files: {size}. Additional free space is required for verification and safety backups.
transfers.forkScope: Copies installed game/loader files, libraries, mods/plugins, allowed configs and the selected world state. Host launch overrides, schedules, backups, logs, DNS/tunnel allocations, shares and panel grants are not inherited. Game listens on loopback; review copied configs for external paths, credentials, shared databases and embedded service ports before configuring access.
transfers.copyScope: Requires matching game/loader builds and identical installed mod/plugin jars; modded loaders also require matching config/defaultconfigs. A complete destination safety backup is mandatory. The world group replaces {name}; trees are never merged.
transfers.replaceConfirm: Replacement is destructive. Type “{name}” to confirm replacing that destination world and its dimensions.
transfers.acknowledge: I reviewed the scope, dependencies, world identity and configuration risks. All external processes using these files are stopped.
transfers.success: Copy committed and verified. The source was not modified.
transfers.publishedFailure: Files were committed, but a later step failed. Do not retry blindly; inspect the destination and safety snapshot.

maps.private: Private BlueMap viewer. Access follows this server's map permissions.
maps.waiting: Waiting for BlueMap and the global-waystones adapter.
maps.disabled: Map access is disabled. An operator must configure it explicitly.
maps.askOperator: Ask a server operator to review the map dependencies and configuration.

maps.controls: Use BlueMap's menu to select a map or dimension, follow live players, and toggle the Global waystones layer.
maps.viewerTitle: Interactive server map with live players and global waystones
maps.setupHelp: Stop the server first. Setup binds BlueMap to loopback, uses one rendering thread, and never opens a public port. Existing operator configuration is not overwritten.
maps.unsupported: This first integration supports Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric 0.18.4 only. Other versions and loaders are not verified.

clientPack.title: Client modpack
clientPack.intro: Create a launcher-importable .mrpack from enabled server mods plus a separate client-only list. Nothing here installs client mods on the server.
clientPack.unsupported: Exports support Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge only. Vanilla, plugin and proxy servers do not produce client modpacks.
clientPack.name: Pack name
clientPack.loaderHelp: New installations record the exact loader version. For older servers, enter the version actually installed, not the latest release.
clientPack.unsaved: Save changes to refresh the review before exporting.
clientPack.requirementHelp: Shared mods keep the exact installed version. Required dependencies are added transitively and become required when needed. Optional is encoded in the pack; not every launcher offers a chooser.
clientPack.empty: No enabled client-compatible mods yet. Add client-only Modrinth mods below or reimport the original pack metadata.
clientPack.clientOnlyHelp: Search the catalog, inspect project details and choose an exact compatible version. These are client-pack selections only, never server installations.
clientPack.noResults: No matching mods for this Minecraft version and loader. Try a different search.
clientPack.noVersion: No version supports this server's game version and loader.
clientPack.overridesHelp: Nothing is selected by default. Only a narrow allowlist of client settings can be included. Review their contents first: no secrets or personal data. Choose either the server or imported copy, never both. Other server configs, worlds, logs and administrative files cannot be exported.
clientPack.noOverrides: No allowlisted client settings are available.
clientPack.importHelp: Upload the original .mrpack to replace retained client metadata without touching the running server. This replaces imported declarations and client override candidates, not your explicit selections. Shared versions still follow installed mods. Missing original files cannot be recovered automatically.
clientPack.downloadHelp: Private by default. Keep up to five exports for 24 hours unless pinned by an active share link. Import the download into a compatible launcher. Refresh sources to check whether a snapshot is outdated.
clientPack.outdated: Outdated: reviewed sources differ from this snapshot.
clientPack.snapshot: Immutable snapshot; current source freshness has not been checked.
clientPack.shareWarning: Anyone with a link can download that archive, including all selected client settings, without signing in. Review the pack for sensitive content before sharing. New generations never change an existing link.
clientPack.shareStorage: Up to 20 active links per server. Links expire in 1 hour to 7 days and pin their archive until expiry. The five-archive, 16 MiB-per-archive limit still applies: if all slots are pinned, revoke links or explicitly delete an archive before generating another.

dns.title: DNS
dns.description: Public hostnames, Minecraft SRV records, and DNS synchronization
dns.connectionHint: Connect to the Fabricator DNS webhook service. Choose Cloudflare or PowerDNS in the service deployment; provider credentials stay there.
dns.enabledHint: Disabling removes Fabricator-owned records on the next synchronization. Stopping a server never removes its records.
dns.webhookHint: Keep this endpoint on a trusted network. Use TLS and an authenticated proxy for remote access. Do not put credentials in the URL.
dns.domainHint: An allowed subtree of the zone. Leave empty to manage the zone itself.
dns.bindingHint: Publish a hostname for this server or proxy. Supply its reachable public endpoint; DNS does not open ports or configure NAT.
dns.configureFirst: Configure a DNS provider in global settings first.
dns.addressHint: One address per line. For Velocity, use the proxy's public address, not a private backend address.
dns.targetHint: Creates a CNAME. Leave IP addresses empty and disable SRV when using a hostname target.
dns.srvHint: Routes the hostname to this server's configured port. Requires explicit IP addresses so the SRV target is not an alias.
dns.copyFailed: Could not copy the join address. Select and copy the hostname manually.
dns.recordsHint: Server bindings are generated separately. Conflicting or unmanaged records will not be overwritten.
dns.noRecords: No manual records yet. Add one below, or publish a hostname from a server's DNS settings.
dns.name: Full DNS name
dns.targetsHint: One target per line. SRV: priority weight port target. MX: priority target. CAA: flags tag "value".
dns.syncHint: Saved changes reconcile automatically. Preview reads the provider's current state; apply synchronizes all pending DNS changes. API success does not prove public delegation or immediate propagation.
dns.saved: DNS configuration saved. Publication is pending synchronization.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.intro: Connect an AI assistant to this panel. It can read your server's status, logs and installed mods — and, with a manage token, start and stop the server or change mods.
mcp.betaNote: {beta} The machine running your AI client needs {uv} installed — without it the client reports the server as failing to launch rather than naming the missing prerequisite. How the client is configured may still change between releases.
mcp.offNote: MCP access is off. Existing tokens stay saved but are rejected until you turn this back on.

mcp.nameHint: So you can tell your tokens apart later.
mcp.readOption: Read only — server status, logs, installed mods.
mcp.manageOption: Read and manage — also start, stop and restart the server, install it, and add or remove mods.
mcp.logsWarning: Logs contain text written by mods and players. An assistant with a manage token can act on what it reads there.
mcp.newTokenBody: Copy it now. It is not stored in readable form and cannot be shown again.
